snippet.title: PlayStation - Himitsu Sentai Metamor V Deluxe (1998) - Intro
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Himitsu Sentai Metamor V Deluxe is an Adventure game, developed by Feycraft and published by Mycom, which was released in Japan in 1998.
